widths.note: north of the bend; 40' from the bend to W 5th

bends.note: runs due south from W 6th, then turns SSE (slope ~0.43) and widens from 20' to 40' down to W 5th

notes: W 5th (66') runs ENE-WSW across the sheet on an iron bridge over the railroad tracks near x 2350-2650 (bridge ignored, street straight). At the SW corner several streets meet in an open junction: W Front comes in from the west (sheet 18), continues on the same alignment as W 5th, and at (642,3572) turns SE (labelled W. FRONT, 66', 20" main) - W 5th's centreline runs straight into that angle point, so it is recorded as W 5th / W Front (T). Freeman Avenue (60') ends at the W Front/W 5th line at (422,3627); its west side meets the block corner at (318,3370) and its east side the corner at (525,3480). Pierson (30') and Hannibal end at W 6th and at W 5th (T). Baymiller (60', diagonal) starts at W 6th (T) and runs SSE; Carlisle Av enters from the east (T, width not printed). Baymiller reaches W 5th just beyond the east paper edge (crossing centre ~(3980,2620), off the sheet, not recorded). 'TOLEDO (DEPOT)' and the B&O freight/passenger depot are railroad features, not streets.
